scenarios.reason: Not operator-accepted; automated saved-session testing does not substitute for human UAT.

details.scope: Completion audit of the named saved-session behavior in docs/session-services-release.md, supplementing SVC-001/002/007/008/010 and the existing seven-App matrices. No new requirement or product behavior change.
details.exactArtifact: Frozen installable archive B, same as both deployed local endpoints. Only XFCE display/ports are relocated in the test package; Core binaries, App script and all other shipped policy remain unchanged. No old immutable package is overwritten.
details.fixture: Fresh locked UID/HOME/account bus per execution; SaveOnExit enabled in that HOME. XFCE Terminal is an actual XSMP client with a saved Mousepad document command. The test never fabricates a saved-session file or relaunches the terminal/editor after login. Mousepad crash-backup restoration is disabled only in this disposable profile to isolate XFCE restoration from the prelude's intentionally terminated editor.
details.precedingFullRun: Attempt 5 passed the full expanded suite. Attempts 6/7 use the final identical harness, additionally measuring and asserting the five-second fault-degradation bound and final App/generation continuity.

failureDisposition.disposition: Preparation stopped before saved logout: a Mousepad modal hid the expected document after the Viewer prelude killed its unsaved editor. Disabled Mousepad's independent after-a-crash restoration only in the disposable profile; the real document then opened. No Core/App fix claimed.

Test process classifier counted Manager's --ibus-engine PATH argument as a running engine. Match the Python interpreter plus script argv instead; retain exact PID/start/cgroup and whole-fixture-UID duplicate checks.

Saved restore and real Viewer checks passed. The subsequent immediate IBus-death query raced identity validation and returned fail-closed 409. The corrected test records transition responses and requires bounded stable not-running/omitted IBus with no App/generation replacement. Attempt 7 reproduced 409 then 200 within 111 ms. No API change or weaker identity validation.

limits: This is XFCE session/command restoration, not recovery of every application's private unsaved-document state.
Native browser/OS IME human UAT remains required. No full OS reboot, production fault injection, sandbox changes, commit/push or formal publication.
details.localDeployment: No deployment/configuration changes. Both local Managers remain active on loopback 1991/2992 with exact rc.2 binary hashes; no Manager warning journal entries during this audit.
